name: Rubric Marine

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: The Rubric Marine may use Ruin actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Only Dust Remains
bonuses.text: The Rubric Marine's physical form is gone and only dust within its armour remains. It is immune to Critical Hits and ignores Wounds from weapons without an AP value.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round.

note: Strength printed 8 with no bracketed pair. Resilience printed '12(5AR)'. Inferno bolt pistol and its 'pistol' trait printed lower case; stored as Inferno Bolt Pistol, Pistol. Determination line is not named and has no Daemons text.
